welcome.title: Welcome to BarHub! 🍻
welcome.description: Discover the best bars, restaurants, and nightlife spots in your city. Share your experiences and connect with fellow bar enthusiasts!

feed.title: Discover Bars
feed.description: Browse through posts from other users to discover amazing bars, restaurants, and nightlife spots in your area.

posts.title: Share Current Occupancy
posts.description: Take photos and share the current occupancy of bars and restaurants in real-time. Show how lively it is and help others know what's happening right now!

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard & Points
leaderboard.description: Earn points for your posts! Get 10 points for each post and 1 point for every like you receive. See the top contributors in the leaderboard.

search.title: Find What You Need
search.description: Use the search feature to find specific bars, restaurants, or browse by location and preferences.

profile.title: Your Profile
profile.description: Manage your profile, view your posts, and customize your experience in the app.

complete.title: You're All Set! 🎉
complete.description: You're ready to explore the best bars and nightlife in your city. Have fun discovering new places!

This will revoke all your consents. You will need to accept them again to continue using the app, or delete your account.

privacy.data-export-explanation: You have the right to receive a copy of all your personal data we store. This includes your profile, posts, likes, reports, favorite places, consents, and more. The data is exported in JSON format, which can be read by most applications.
privacy.consent-withdrawal-explanation: You have the right to withdraw your consent for us to process your personal data at any time. If you withdraw consent, you will need to either re-accept our terms to continue using the app, or delete your account. This action cannot be undone.
privacy.gdpr-rights-explanation: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability, and to object to processing of your personal data. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
